The following events took place in '''25,793 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Force Wars]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] begin between the followers of Ashla and the followers of Bogan.
*[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was conquered by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].
*The Infinite Empire launches a campaign of conquest against the [[Je'daii Order]] and the [[Settled Worlds]].
